title: TailoredCV
description: Structured output shape for the rebuild path's LLM tailor (cv_tailor.tailor_cv_structured). Maps 1:1 to the cv_modern.html Jinja template so no text parser sits between the LLM and the renderer — the bug surface that produced the Run 25 catastrophe is eliminated. Inspired by rendercv's typed-entry schema but trimmed to exactly what our template renders.

candidate_name.description: Display name as it appears at the top of the CV.

contact_bits.description: Header contact line, split into pieces joined by a dot separator. Plain text only — do not include icon class names ('MOBILE-ALT', 'Envelope', etc.) which the renderer treats as literal characters.

summary.description: Professional Summary paragraph. Empty string if none.

sections.description: Ordered list of CV sections. Each section renders as an <h2> followed by its roles and paragraphs.

roles.description: Role/entry blocks. Each renders as a title + dates + optional subtitle + bullet list. Use this for Experience, Education (treat degree as title), and Projects sections.

paragraphs.description:
Free-form paragraphs for sections without role structure (e.g. Skills lines like 'Product: roadmap, OKRs, RICE'). Rendered as

blocks.

title.description: Role / degree / project name (the primary identifier of this entry).

dates.description: Date range (e.g. 'Jun 2021 - Present', 'Sep 2018 - Jul 2022'). Plain text — no en-dashes; the ATS normalizer strips them.

sub.description: Subtitle: organisation / institution / location / grade. Anything that belongs on a second line under the title.

bullets.description: Bullet points. Each will render as an <li>. Use one sentence per bullet.
